description: This file defines a JSONStorage class that manages thread-safe operations for storing, loading, updating, and filtering JSON data files within a specified directory. It includes methods for appending new items with metadata, updating existing items, retrieving items by ID, and filtering data based on criteria.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: A thread-safe manager for JSON file storage, supporting load, save, append, update, get by ID, and filter operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JSONStorage with a specified cache directory path and creates the directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: _get_file_path
methods.description: Constructs the full file path for a given filename, appending '.json' if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and returns data from a JSON file; returns an empty list if the file does not exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided data list to a JSON file; returns True if successful.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a new item to the JSON file, adding metadata such as 'id' and 'created_at'.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing item identified by 'id' with new data and adds an 'updated_at' timestamp.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a single item by its 'id' from the JSON data.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters and returns items matching specified key-value criteria.
